cases.question: 按渠道拆一下
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS channel_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS gmv FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary: 上个月GMV按渠道：自然搜索2187727.11最高，社交种草1413708.8次之，品牌广告437547.54最低。

cases.question: 换成按退款原因看
cases.sql: SELECT r.reason, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amt FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY refund_amt DESC LIMIT 10
cases.summary: 上个月退款金额最高的原因是七天无理由，共66500.84元。
